pageTitle: TCCL Playground — write and simulate smart contracts
pageDescription: Write TCCL contracts in the browser and run them on the real TCCL engine compiled to WebAssembly, with fictitious accounts, state before and after, events and estimated costs.
bannerText: This page runs the real TCCL compiler and virtual machine inside your browser with fictitious accounts. No keys, no recovery phrases, no network.
noscript: The playground needs JavaScript and WebAssembly.
deployHelp: Deploys the code in the editor to the in-browser chain. The deployer becomes the upgrade authority unless you tick “final”.
functionsEmpty: Deploy a contract to call its actions and views.
upgradeHelp: Replaces the selected contract's code with the code in the editor. Only its upgrade authority can do it; the stored state is kept and must stay compatible.
stateEmpty: Deploy a contract to see its state.
activityHelp: Every simulated transaction, newest first: result or explained error, events, fuel and estimated costs with The Coin's default parameters.
scenarioHelp: A scenario is a small test script: deploy, call, expect. It runs in a fresh simulated chain.
sessionHelp: Height, balances and contracts live only in this tab. Export the session to continue later.
limit1: The engine runs in a Web Worker; a request that takes more than 5 seconds is stopped.
limit2: Each call has at most 5 000 000 fuel and 16 MiB of values, the same rules as language version 2 on the network.
limit3: At most 32 contracts per session and 1 000 lines per scenario.
limit4: Fees and storage deposits are estimates; real fees depend on the network's current parameters and congestion.
timeout: Stopped: the request took more than 5 seconds. The simulated session was reset.
